items.title: Wendell Harrison interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 10, 2022 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer ('My name is Monk Rowe') and Wendell Harrison as the interviewee. No personal or professional relationship beyond the interview context is described.

ctx.x: Wendell was interviewed via Zoom on November 10, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very, very pleased to have Wendell Harrison with me today. And it requires sort of a long introduction: saxophonist and composer and record producer and community activist, and probably other things too. Kudos on your career so far.
Well thank you, thank you, thank you. It’s an honor to talk about my legacy and all my years in struggle, every one of them.

items.title: Wendell Harrison interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 17, 2022 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and I’m pleased to be back with Wendell Harrison for a few follow-up questions.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe and I’m pleased to be back with Wendell Harrison for a few follow-up questions. And you’re looking good, as you did last time.
Oh thank you. Thank you, thank you. That means a whole lot at my age. I’m still here. Yeah.

items.title: Wendell Harrison interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 17, 2022 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: The priest of jazz, the Monk. I love it.

ctx.x: You’ve got the right name. The priest of jazz, the Monk. I love it.
Thank you very much for your time, Wendell.
